diagnosis.start.title: Answer 3 questions to get today's task
diagnosis.start.lead.1: For anyone from first-time coders to working engineers. One task a day, 15 minutes (10 for Beginner): read, pick an answer for 3 questions, and see right away whether you were right and why.
diagnosis.start.lead.2: No sign-up. Your data stays in this browser and is never sent anywhere.
diagnosis.start.lead.3: The level adjusts automatically from the next task, based on how many you get right.
home.standalone.import: Data entered in another browser is not carried over automatically. If you exported a file, you can import it here.
home.addToHomeScreen.title: We recommend adding this to your Home Screen before you start
home.addToHomeScreen.why: Safari may delete this site's saved data after 7 days without use. A Home Screen copy of 今日の一手 is not affected.
home.addToHomeScreen.steps.1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the screen (top on iPad).
home.addToHomeScreen.steps.2: Choose "Add to Home Screen", then tap "Add".
home.addToHomeScreen.steps.3: Open 今日の一手 from your Home Screen and start the diagnosis.
home.addToHomeScreen.steps.4: If you already did the diagnosis in Safari: Safari's data is not carried over. In Safari, open Settings and tap "Export to a file"; then in the Home Screen copy, open Settings and tap "Import a file".
